title.en: When a frame is lost: Go-Back-N and Selective Repeat (Q6)
title.zh: 一帧出错之后：回退 N 帧和选择重传（第 6 题）

description.en: Why a sender needs acknowledgements, timeouts and sequence numbers, why it keeps several frames in flight, and what Go-Back-N and Selective Repeat each do when one frame in the middle is damaged.
description.zh: 发送方为什么需要确认、超时和序号，为什么要同时让好几帧在路上，以及中间一帧坏了时，回退 N 帧和选择重传各怎么做。

name.en: Flow control, stop and wait, ARQ
name.zh: 流量控制与停等协议 (flow control, stop and wait, ARQ)

name.en: Sliding window: go-back-N and selective repeat
name.zh: 滑动窗口：回退 N 与选择重传 (go-back-N, selective repeat)

description.en: Mixing up which frames Go-Back-N and Selective Repeat send again
description.zh: 把回退 N 帧和选择重传各重发哪些帧搞混

title.zh: 模拟卷 · 第 6 题（3 分）

paras.en: Give the name of one sliding window protocol and briefly explain how that protocol works at the Data Link Layer when a transmission error occurs.
paras.zh: 写出一种滑动窗口协议的名称，并简要说明发生传输错误时，该协议在数据链路层是怎样工作的。

items.en: **A sliding window protocol** lets the sender have several frames on their way before any of them is acknowledged. The course has two: **Go-Back-N** and **Selective Repeat**. Name one.
items.zh: **滑动窗口协议**让发送方在收到确认之前，就能有好几帧同时在路上。课上讲了两种：**回退 N 帧**（Go-Back-N）和**选择重传**（Selective Repeat）。写出其中一种。

items.en: **A transmission error**: a frame arrives damaged (its checksum fails, so it is thrown away) or does not arrive at all. To the protocol the two look the same: a frame is missing.
items.zh: **传输错误**：一帧到达时坏了（校验和不对，于是被扔掉），或者根本没到。对协议来说两者是一回事：少了一帧。

items.en: **How that protocol works**: what the receiver does with the missing frame and with the good frames behind it, what tells the sender, and what the sender sends again. 3 marks: the name, the receiver's side, the sender's side.
items.zh: **该协议怎样工作**：接收方怎么处理缺的那一帧、以及排在它后面的好帧，什么告诉发送方出了事，发送方重发什么。3 分：名称、接收方、发送方。

title.en: Acknowledge, time out, number the frames

text.en: Start with the simplest sender: send one frame, wait for an **acknowledgement** (ACK), then send the next. The ACK also protects a slow receiver, which is never sent more than it has acknowledged.
text.zh: 从最简单的发送方说起：发一帧，等一个**确认**（ACK），再发下一帧。确认也保护了慢的接收方：它确认多少，才会收到多少。

text.en: On a noisy channel, frames get lost or damaged, and a damaged frame is discarded, so it is a loss too. The sender would wait forever, so it starts a **timer** for each frame and sends the frame again if no ACK comes back in time. But perhaps the frame arrived and only the ACK was lost; then the receiver gets the same frame twice. So frames carry **sequence numbers**, and the receiver can tell a new frame from a copy. ACKs, timeouts and sequence numbers together are **ARQ** (automatic repeat request). Sending one frame at a time this way is **stop-and-wait**.
text.zh: 信道有噪声时，帧会丢或坏，坏的帧会被扔掉，所以也等于丢了。发送方会永远等下去，于是它给每帧开一个**计时器**，到时还没等到确认，就重发。可也许帧到了，丢的只是确认；那接收方就会收到同一帧两次。所以帧要带**序号**，接收方才能分清新帧和副本。确认、超时、序号合起来叫 **ARQ**（自动重传请求）。这样一次只发一帧，就是**停等协议**（stop-and-wait）。

title.en: How much of the link stop-and-wait uses
title.zh: 停等协议用掉了多少链路

say.en: Each cycle: $T_f$ to put the frame on the link (the transmission delay), $T_p$ for it to reach the receiver, $T_p$ for the ACK to come back. The link carries data only during $T_f$; the **utilisation** $U$ is that share.
say.zh: 每一轮：$T_f$ 把帧放上链路（发送时延），$T_p$ 传到接收方，再 $T_p$ 等确认回来。链路只有在 $T_f$ 里在运数据；**利用率** $U$ 就是这一段所占的比例。

say.en: The course's example: a 10 kb frame on a 1 Mbps link, with $T_p = 50$ ms.
say.zh: 课上的例子：1 Mbps 的链路，10 kb 的帧，$T_p = 50$ ms。

say.en: The sender spends 100 ms of every 110 waiting.
say.zh: 每 110 ms 里，发送方有 100 ms 在等。

say.en: To keep the link busy, the sender must have enough frames in flight to fill a whole cycle: 11 here.
say.zh: 要让链路一直忙，发送方得有足够多的帧在路上，填满一整轮：这里要 11 帧。

outro.en: That is the reason for sliding windows: keep sending while the ACKs are on their way.
outro.zh: 这就是滑动窗口的由来：在确认回来的路上，继续发。

prompt.en: How long does it take to put a 10 kb frame onto a 1 Mbps link, in ms?
prompt.zh: 把 10 kb 的帧放上 1 Mbps 的链路要多久？单位 ms。

title.en: A window of frames, and an error in the middle
title.zh: 一窗的帧，中间坏了一个

text.en: In a **sliding window** protocol the sender keeps a **sending window**, the sequence numbers it may send without waiting, and the receiver a **receiving window**, the sequence numbers it will accept. Each ACK slides the sender's window forward. Stop-and-wait is the case of a window of 1.
text.zh: 在**滑动窗口**协议里，发送方维护一个**发送窗口**，即不用等就可以发的那些序号；接收方维护一个**接收窗口**，即它肯收的那些序号。每来一个确认，发送窗口就往前滑。停等协议就是窗口为 1 的情形。

text.en: Now the question's case. Frames 0 to 4 are in flight and frame 1 is damaged. Frames 2, 3 and 4 arrive intact, but after a gap. What should the receiver do with them? The two protocols answer differently.
text.zh: 现在看题目说的情形。帧 0 到 4 都在路上，帧 1 坏了。帧 2、3、4 完好地到了，可前面缺了一帧。接收方该拿它们怎么办？两个协议的回答不一样。

alt.en: Two timelines with frames 0 to 4 and frame 1 damaged. Go-Back-N: the receiver discards frames 2, 3 and 4; the sender times out and resends 1, 2, 3 and 4. Selective Repeat: the receiver buffers 2, 3 and 4 and sends NAK 1; the sender resends 1 only; the receiver delivers 1 to 4 and sends ACK 4.
alt.zh: 两条时间线，帧 0 到 4，帧 1 坏了。回退 N 帧：接收方丢弃帧 2、3、4；发送方超时，重发 1、2、3、4。选择重传：接收方缓存 2、3、4，发出 NAK 1；发送方只重发 1；接收方按顺序交付 1 到 4，发出 ACK 4。

caption.en: Left: Go-Back-N throws away everything after the gap and the sender goes back to frame 1. Right: Selective Repeat keeps the good frames and asks for frame 1 alone.
caption.zh: 左：回退 N 帧把缺口后面的全扔掉，发送方退回帧 1 重来。右：选择重传留下好帧，只要帧 1。

items.en: **Go-Back-N**: the receiver's window is 1, so it accepts frames only in order. It discards the damaged frame *and every frame after it*, and sends no acknowledgement for them until the next in-sequence frame arrives. The sender's timer for frame 1 runs out, and it goes back: it resends frame 1 and every frame after it. The receiver needs no buffer; the cost is resending good frames.
items.zh: **回退 N 帧**：接收窗口是 1，只按顺序收。它扔掉坏帧*以及后面所有的帧*，在下一个按序的帧到来之前，不为它们发确认。发送方帧 1 的计时器到时，于是退回去：重发帧 1 以及之后的每一帧。接收方不需要缓冲区；代价是好帧也被重发了。

items.en: **Selective Repeat**: the receiver's window is larger than 1, so it accepts the good frames behind the gap and **buffers** them. It sends a **NAK** (negative acknowledgement) for frame 1, which makes the sender resend it before its timer runs out. The sender resends frame 1 only. When it arrives, the receiver hands frames 1 to 4 to the network layer in order, and its **cumulative ACK** names the highest frame received in order, ACK 4. Nothing good is resent; the cost is the buffer.
items.zh: **选择重传**：接收窗口大于 1，所以缺口后面的好帧它照收，先**缓存**起来。它为帧 1 发一个 **NAK**（否定确认），让发送方不必等计时器到时就重发。发送方只重发帧 1。帧 1 一到，接收方把帧 1 到 4 按顺序交给网络层，并发一个**累积确认**，指明按序收到的最高帧号：ACK 4。好帧一个都不用重发；代价是缓冲区。

prompt.en: Frames 0 to 4 are sent with Go-Back-N and frame 1 is damaged. Which frames does the sender send again?
prompt.zh: 用回退 N 帧发出帧 0 到 4，帧 1 坏了。发送方要重发哪些帧？

feedback.en: That is Selective Repeat. In Go-Back-N the receiver threw 2, 3 and 4 away, so they must come again.
feedback.zh: 那是选择重传。回退 N 帧里接收方把 2、3、4 扔了，所以它们也得重发。

feedback.en: Frame 1 is the one that was damaged: everything resent starts from it.
feedback.zh: 坏的就是帧 1：重发从它开始。

explain.en: The receiver accepts only in order, so it discards everything after the gap, and the sender goes back to the damaged frame and resends from there.
explain.zh: 接收方只按顺序收，缺口之后的全丢；发送方退回坏帧，从那里重发。

text.en: Three marks, three links: the name; what the receiver does with the damaged frame and with the frames behind it; what the sender resends, and what makes it resend. Selective Repeat is written out here; Go-Back-N earns the same marks.
text.zh: 3 分，三环：名称；接收方怎么处理坏帧和它后面的帧；发送方重发什么、什么促使它重发。这里写的是选择重传；写回退 N 帧同样得分。

title.en: Practice exam, Q6 · a full-mark answer
title.zh: 模拟卷第 6 题 · 满分答案

paras.en: Selective Repeat. When a frame arrives damaged (or is lost), the receiver discards it but keeps the correctly received frames that follow it in its buffer, and sends a negative acknowledgement (NAK) for the missing frame. On the NAK (or when its timer expires), the sender retransmits only that frame. When it arrives, the receiver passes it and the buffered frames to the network layer in order, and sends a cumulative acknowledgement for the highest in-order frame received.
paras.zh: 选择重传（Selective Repeat）。一帧到达时损坏（或丢失）时，接收方丢弃它，但把之后正确收到的帧保存在缓冲区中，并为缺失的帧发送否定确认（NAK）。收到 NAK（或计时器到时）后，发送方只重传这一帧。该帧到达后，接收方把它和缓存的帧按顺序交给网络层，并对按序收到的最高帧发送累积确认。

paras.en: (Alternatively, Go-Back-N: the receiver discards the damaged frame and all frames after it, sending no acknowledgements for them; the sender's timer for the damaged frame expires, and it retransmits that frame and every frame sent after it.)
paras.zh: （也可以写回退 N 帧：接收方丢弃损坏的帧以及其后的所有帧，不为它们发送确认；发送方该帧的计时器到时后，重传这一帧以及之后发出的每一帧。）

title.zh: 回退 N 帧对比选择重传

rows.en: the lost frame and all after it

text.en: The course sums it up as a trade-off between using the bandwidth efficiently and the buffer space at the data link layer. Go-Back-N also needs its timeout set with care on slow or long links, since a frame may still be on its way when the timer runs out.
text.zh: 课上把它总结成一个取舍：带宽用得省，还是数据链路层的缓冲区占得少。回退 N 帧在慢速或长距离的链路上还要小心设置超时：计时器到时，帧可能还在路上。

text.en: How large a window, with $n$-bit sequence numbers
text.zh: 序号有 $n$ 位时，窗口能开多大

text.en: Sequence numbers wrap around: with $n$ bits they run from 0 to $2^n - 1$ and start again. The window must be small enough that a resent old frame can never be mistaken for a new one.
text.zh: 序号会循环：$n$ 位的序号从 0 数到 $2^n - 1$，再从头开始。窗口必须足够小，保证重发的旧帧永远不会被当成新帧。

items.en: **Go-Back-N: at most $2^n - 1$.** Suppose the window were all $2^n$ numbers, 0 to 7 with 3 bits. The sender sends 0 to 7, and all eight arrive but every ACK is lost. The sender times out and resends 0 to 7, while the receiver now expects a new frame 0, so it takes the old frame 0 for the new one. One number fewer avoids it.
items.zh: **回退 N 帧：最多 $2^n - 1$。**假设窗口用满全部 $2^n$ 个序号，3 位时就是 0 到 7。发送方发出 0 到 7，八帧都到了，可确认全丢了。发送方超时，重发 0 到 7；接收方此时在等新的帧 0，于是把旧的帧 0 当成了新的。少用一个序号就能避免。

items.en: **Selective Repeat: at most $2^{n-1}$.** The receiver accepts any frame in its window. If all the ACKs are lost, its window has already moved on by a full window, and the resent old frames must not fall inside it: the two windows must not overlap, so each can be at most half the numbers.
items.zh: **选择重传：最多 $2^{n-1}$。**接收方收窗口里的任何一帧。如果确认全丢了，它的窗口已经往前挪了整整一窗，重发的旧帧绝不能落进新窗口：前后两个窗口不能重叠，所以每个最多只能占一半的序号。

text.en: With 3-bit sequence numbers: Go-Back-N up to 7, Selective Repeat up to 4.
text.zh: 序号 3 位时：回退 N 帧最多 7，选择重传最多 4。

prompt.en: With Selective Repeat, frames 0 to 5 are sent and frame 3 is damaged. Which frames does the sender send again?
prompt.zh: 用选择重传发出帧 0 到 5，帧 3 坏了。发送方要重发哪些帧？

feedback.en: That is Go-Back-N. Here the receiver buffered 4 and 5.
feedback.zh: 那是回退 N 帧。这里接收方已经把 4 和 5 缓存了。

feedback.en: Frames 0, 1 and 2 arrived and were acknowledged.
feedback.zh: 帧 0、1、2 都到了，也确认了。

explain.en: The receiver keeps 4 and 5 and sends a NAK for 3; only 3 is sent again, then 3, 4 and 5 are delivered in order.
explain.zh: 接收方留着 4 和 5，为 3 发 NAK；只重发 3，然后 3、4、5 按顺序交付。

prompt.en: Selective Repeat uses 4-bit sequence numbers. What is the largest window it can use?
prompt.zh: 选择重传用 4 位序号。窗口最大能开多少？

explain.en: $2^{4-1} = 8$: half of the 16 sequence numbers, so that the old and new receiving windows never overlap. (Go-Back-N could use 15.)
explain.zh: $2^{4-1} = 8$：16 个序号的一半，这样新旧两个接收窗口才不会重叠。（回退 N 帧可以用 15。）

title.zh: 你来：用自己的话写回退 N 帧

prompt.en: Explain how Go-Back-N works at the data link layer when a transmission error occurs.
prompt.zh: 说明发生传输错误时，回退 N 帧在数据链路层是怎样工作的。

key_points.en: The receiver accepts frames only in order (receiving window 1)
key_points.zh: 接收方只按顺序收帧（接收窗口为 1）

key_points.en: It discards the damaged frame and all frames after it, with no acknowledgement for them
key_points.zh: 它丢弃坏帧及其后的所有帧，不为它们发确认

key_points.en: The sender's timer for the damaged frame expires, and it resends that frame and all frames after it
key_points.zh: 发送方该帧的计时器到时，重发这一帧及其后的所有帧

model_answer.en: In Go-Back-N the receiver's window is 1, so it accepts frames only in order. When a frame is damaged, the receiver discards it and every frame that follows, and sends no acknowledgement for them. The sender's timer for the damaged frame expires, so it goes back and retransmits that frame and every frame sent after it.
model_answer.zh: 回退 N 帧的接收窗口是 1，只按顺序收帧。一帧坏了，接收方丢掉它和后面的每一帧，也不为它们发确认。发送方这一帧的计时器到时，于是退回去，重发这一帧以及之后发出的每一帧。

explain.en: Go-Back-N trades bandwidth (good frames resent) for a receiver that needs no buffer.
explain.zh: 回退 N 帧用带宽（好帧也重发）换来一个不需要缓冲区的接收方。
